title: Calendar preview month grid actually fills the widget now
summary: Found the real cause of the earlier 'giant cells, only one week visible' bug: grid-auto-rows:1fr is shorthand for minmax(auto, 1fr), and that 'auto' minimum still respected each day cell's own min-height floor, so once six rows' worth of floors exceeded the widget's real height, the grid overflowed and needed scrolling instead of shrinking to fit.

Switched to minmax(0, 1fr), which removes that floor from the grid's own sizing math (each cell's min-height still applies whenever there's room) -- the month grid now evenly fills whatever vertical space the widget actually has, growing when you resize it larger instead of stopping around half height.
